Assistant (0.2s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Bell?

User (1.3s): Yes, this is Marcus Bell.

Assistant (1.8s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (2.8s): Nineteen October nineteen eighty three.

Assistant (4.5s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (5.4s): four four zero one.

Assistant (7.0s): That does not match our records. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (8.1s): four four one zero.

Assistant (9.3s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about late payments. First, your credit card ending 9015 has a past-due amount of 510.00, which is 16 days late. Second, your personal loan has a past-due amount of 1320.00, which is 16 days late. Third, your car loan has a past-due amount of 140.00, which is 7 days late. Can you pay all of them today?

User (10.8s): I can pay the credit card tomorrow, but I will not pay the personal loan or the car loan.

Assistant (12.4s): I understand you can pay the credit card tomorrow. Regarding your personal loan, can you make a payment of 1320.00 on Friday 16 October 2026?

User (14.3s): I will not pay the personal loan.

Assistant (16.9s): I understand. For your personal loan, can you make a payment of 440.00 on Friday 23 October 2026? The rest stays overdue.

User (18.4s): I will not pay that.

Assistant (19.6s): I understand. For your car loan, can you make a payment of 140.00 on Friday 16 October 2026?

User (21.5s): I will not pay the car loan.

Assistant (23.6s): To confirm: you will pay 510.00 for the credit card ending 9015 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm?

User (25.7s): Yes, I confirm.

Assistant (26.7s): Thank you, one moment please.

Assistant (27.8s): Thank you. Your promise of 510.00 for the credit card ending 9015 on Thursday 15 October 2026 is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
